vulnerable_code:
class TaxReturns::AttachmentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_taxpayer!

  def download
    # BOLA: Fetches ActiveStorage::Attachment by primary key id directly
    # without checking if attachment.record belongs to current_taxpayer
    attachment = ActiveStorage::Attachment.find(params[:id])

    send_data attachment.download,
              filename: attachment.filename.to_s,
              content_type: attachment.content_type,
              disposition: 'attachment'
  end
end
diagnosis: The download action fetches ActiveStorage::Attachment directly by primary key without checking if the parent record (TaxReturn) belongs to current_taxpayer. Any authenticated taxpayer can download Form 1040s and W-2 statements containing Social Security Numbers and income filings belonging to any other citizen by altering the attachment ID.

corrected_code:
class TaxReturns::AttachmentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_taxpayer!

  def download
    tax_return = current_taxpayer.tax_returns.find(params[:tax_return_id])
    attachment = tax_return.tax_document_attachment

    send_data attachment.download,
              filename: attachment.filename.to_s,
              content_type: attachment.content_type,
              disposition: 'attachment'
  end
end
